title: Regulatory Requirement
description: A single security-relevant requirement extracted from a primary regulatory text.

article.description: Article number as printed in the OJ, e.g. '15' or '21'.

paragraph.description: Paragraph or sub-paragraph reference if applicable.

recital.description: Optional recital reference if the requirement is illuminated by a specific recital.

text.description: Verbatim or near-verbatim quotation of the operative requirement.

security_domain.description: Tags grouping requirements by operational security domain.

source_url.description: EUR-Lex URL to the consolidated version where possible.

last_verified.description: Date the citation was last reconciled against the source text.

notes.description: Editorial note, e.g. 'corrigendum applied' or 'see also Annex IV'.
